name: payment-processing-api (Spring Boot, MySQL, Redis)
task: Develop a payment processing REST API using Spring Boot, MySQL and Redis.

criteria.description: Meets every acceptance criterion; builds and tests run.
Layering, module boundaries, matches approved HLD/LLD.
Same key returns original result; concurrent retries create one charge.
Minimal scope, no remote call inside a DB transaction, explicit rollback.
AuthN/Z, validation, no secrets in code, no card data stored.
Stable error contract, no leaked internals, failure paths covered.
AC-mapped tests incl. negative and boundary; real executed results.
Indexes justified, pool sizing reasoned, claims measured.
README, API spec, ADRs, traceability, honest limitations.

scoring: Each criterion 0-10 with a written rationale from the evaluator who actually ran the skill; weighted to 100 by kw-skills eval score.
